scope: text session policy only; full state/approval gate pending

tests.name: Only the exact approved instruction source and fingerprint are accepted
A changed context is blocked before budget reservation or turn dispatch
Context is rechecked after an asynchronous reservation immediately before dispatch
Context excludes inherited instructions, skills, environment access and tool capabilities
Unknown skill inventory and unexpected thread settings fail before any turn
Only bounded explicit text is accepted; paths or tool inputs cannot be injected
Rejected reservation sends no turn and closes the owned session
Cross-thread text is ignored and provider failure cannot become success
Provider terminal text is required; valid events retain correlated identity
Late events from another turn in the same thread cannot replace the new result
